tasks.description: Implement private undo of a routine soil-check completion and safe re-completion of the same due occurrence.
constraints: Current accepted base 1196591. Author a valid unified Git patch in the JSON patch field. Use full exact git hunk context, separate diff --git headers, and all added lines of the new file prefixed +. The controller applies and tests.

Forward-only SQL, do not edit 051–053. Private execute_routine_soil_check_undo taking owner ID, operation ID, plant ID, entry ID. Deny EXECUTE to public/anon/authenticated/service_role until a later Edge adapter. Use existing owner and plant locks, care_reversals and operation_receipts. Only allow an active completed ordinary check_soil entry linked to its owner/plant basic-care task and rule. Never touch first aid or watering. No changes to other fixtures/settings.

Exact replay returns previous receipt even when access later changes; a different operation cannot reverse the same fact twice. Undo remains possible after expiry, as manual journal history. Atomically void the entry, record a reversal and mark the completed task as superseded with reminders off, retaining its linkage. The next projection drops the voided fact; if underlying rule still applies this restores the prior date.

Update completion forward so the same valid due occurrence can be completed again after undo without a duplicate active fact: reuse only the exact task associated with a voided routine check, preserve historical journal/reversal, and never reopen reminders as a side effect. Existing owner lock and expected due conflict stay authoritative. Preserve original stored receipt and exact prior replay.

Extend existing synthetic fixture with undo/replay/foreign rejection/expiry/unchanged water and quota and same-occurrence re-completion. Keep 051–053 cutoffs working. No Edge, iOS, new provider, future reminders, automated jobs or staging changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Forward-only exact SQL diff stays within scope.
Clean/upgrade verifies exact reversal, eligibility, linked history and one new active check after undo.
